design.scope: Primary19families*3sizes*3seeds=171inputs,16methods*3repeats=8208sorts. Two fresh anchor sessions,each11fixed inputs*16methods*5repeats=880sorts,1760total. Primary+anchors9968sorts excluding warm/preflight. Ordinary14 aggregates separate from5diagnostics. Sorted/reverse ramps same bytes acrossseeds; partialshares ramp multiset. Anchors repeat first value seed,not new input independence.
design.reuse: Frozen F1 C++ source included unmodified; original E_cpp calls same Ecpp function. E_js invokes frozen original E. F1 data are historical comparison,never pooled numerically with M. Same compiler/Boost versions pinned,official header hashes captured.
design.controls: Node fixed12/active8/active12 use original E.run. C++ matching controls share std::sort backend. E_pdq copies frozen E decision logic/RNG/budgets with pdqsort fallback and leaves; active12_pdq same pdq leaf. These are backend ablations,not original E replacement. Every E_js/E_cpp/E_pdq choice checked on identical input/round.
design.baselines: Official Boost1.90.0 integer_sort(Spreadsort),pdqsort,spinsort and sample_sort(request4threads). Sample4 resources separate. F1 reference samplesort/wrapper already tested; not rerun or presented as optimized state-of-art. Tested implementations do not prove superiority over all sorting methods.
design.affinity: CONFIG worker pins benchmark Node and C++ child processes to lowest available logical CPU in inherited affinity mask; only these child processes modified. sample4 temporarily uses original inherited C++ CPU mask,then restores. No OS power/priority/global setting changes. Masks logged. CPU0-class not assumed. CPUfrequency/OSload/GC stillnot isolated.
design.timing: Same uint32LE input files and SHA256. C++ echoes loaded ordered bytes; Node verifies echoSHA equals inputSHA before sorts. Per-call method order randomized across all16 JS/C++ methods,one sort at a time; protocol/fileIO/startup/clone/checks/warm excluded. Algorithm analysis/RNG/allocation/scatter/sort/copy timed. Node GC overlaps observed,not subtracted. CPP raw correctness whole vector against same native expected.
design.metrics: Per-input3-run medians then geometric means over14ordinary*3value seeds per size. Per-family ms/ratios and observed worst regressions+same-case extra ms. E vs forcedactive controls isolate partition/selection; E_cpp vsstd,E_pdq vspdq backend-specific. Analysis-subtracted time diagnostic only,not executablefree analysis. Anchor process ratios and selection repeatability reported separately,not pooled withprimary.
design.memory: Explicit E partition workspace:Node4n+12B+4bytes;C++4n+24B+16bytes plus sample/container/internal stack memory not quantified. Native/competitor internal memory not directly profiled; no peak-memory ranking. Input/expected/clone harness buffers excluded from these counts.
design.limitations: One Intel machine,controlled child CPU affinity and fresh-process anchors only;no second independent machine available in this executor. Reproduction bundle includes binary/source/pinned dependency manifest. No universalbest/novelty/CI/significance/worst-case claims. No E heuristic tuning.
